desc: Derive and validate the BFS-layer-size DP with states for used vertices, even-distance count, last-layer size, and layer-depth parity.
Prove the adjacent-layer edge factor via inclusion–exclusion and combine it with within-layer edges and factorial label weights.
Design the evaluation/interpolation implementation and establish its time and memory complexity for \(N\le 30\).
Check the derivation on \(N=2,4,6\), compare with the samples, and investigate boundary cases such as \(M=N-1\) and the complete graph.
Implement the final modular algorithm, carefully handling polynomial coefficient ranges and output formatting.
